sources.name: USFQ - Veterinary Medical Teaching Hospital (HDEV)
sources.note: Opened (university page); has a '24 hour emergencies' heading and says '24-hour care, 365 days a year' in the Cumbaya area. No address, phone or email in the text (contact section is an image). node/47 shows the same.

sources.name: USFQ - TUERI Wildlife Hospital
sources.note: Opened; wildlife hospital next to the HDEV (Diego de Robles and Pampite, Cumbaya), open 24 h / 365 days for receiving animals and emergencies, free; phones (+593) 990 537 004 (emergencies) and 099 053 7004; tueri@usfq.edu.ec. Wildlife only, not pets.

sources.name: El Yex - Clinica Veterinaria Municipal Urbanimal Quito
sources.note: Opened; news article (dated 27 Feb 2023 / 27 Jul 2026 on two copies): Francisco Fuertes y Gaspar Cujias, San Bartolo, south Quito; phone (02) 395 2300; consultations Mon-Fri 08:00-16:30; says animals are received 24 hours a day; all services free. Hours and 24 h claim are inconsistent, so not marked 24 h.

sources.name: El Comercio - Clinica Veterinaria de la Universidad Central
sources.note: Opened; Mon-Fri 08:00-16:00, walk-ins until about 15:00, has an emergency area; no address, phone or 24 h statement.

sources.name: Diario El Mercurio - Hospital Municipal de la Mascota (Cuenca, Feb 2024)
sources.note: Opened; Mon-Fri 08:00-17:00, six vets, no weekends/holidays, inside the complejo bolivariano near the Jefferson Perez coliseum; no phone. Emergencies (run-over/abandoned pets) are covered by an agreement between the municipal environmental commission and Fundacion ARCA.

sources.name: Primicias - Hospital municipal de la mascota Cuenca (Aug 2023)
sources.note: Opened; location Av. 12 de Abril and Unidad Nacional (Jefferson Perez coliseum complex), services for dogs and cats; no phone, hours or 24 h.

sources.name: Diario El Mercurio - Patrulla Canina Cuenca (June 2025)
sources.note: Opened; municipal animal-emergency/abuse patrol, phone 0987050437, Mon-Fri 08:00-17:00 (run-over, poisoning, abandonment). Rescue patrol, not a clinic; not listed as an entry.

sources.name: Primicias - Guayaquil animal rescue unit of the fire brigade (2022)

Cuenca Patrulla Canina line 0987050437 (Mon-Fri 08:00-17:00) is a municipal rescue patrol, not listed.

notes: Research 2026-11-12. Few verifiable sources: WebSearch returned mostly news articles and directories; clinics' own websites, Agrocalidad, the Colegio de Medicos Veterinarios and Quito's Unidad de Bienestar Animal did not surface as openable pages with clinic contact data (Quito's registry 'Registra tu Huella' has no public list found). No 24 h private clinic with its own page was found in Quito, Guayaquil or Cuenca; none in Galapagos (Puerto Ayora / San Cristobal), Manta/Salinas/Montanita, Banos, Loja, Ambato (only NGO/charity articles about Galapagos pets, no clinic contact data). No animal poison line found (CIATOX 1800-VENENO is for humans, not listed). No duty rota found. Not entries: Cuenca Patrulla Canina 0987050437, Guayaquil fire-brigade animal rescue via 911, Cuenca clinics named only in blogs/news without phone (Villa Club Animal, D'Pelo Medic, Hospital Veterinario San Francisco, Clinica La Herradura). Guayaquil: no clinic with contact data found (Isla Puna municipal vet unit mentioned without contact).
